race.comment: RASHFORD (5) is worth another chance after a near miss at Townsville. His prior fifth here was better than it looked, and the booking of gun hoop Wiggins boosts his chances. Draws well and can get the job done this time. REPLACE THE ACE (3) is a track specialist and poses the main threat. Is yet to strike through this prep but should be at his top now and has enough early toe to cross and lead. MISSILE BABY (8) is lightly raced, finishing second at Rocky, just over half a length back with market support. She steps up in grade but has a good overall record at the distance. DECIMUS (6) faces a tougher task, yet his Open-grade third at Rocky and earlier form against RASHFORD keep him in the mix.
